description: Copy one ad creative's image from Sightglass into the Replo project's Assets, so it can be used as a reference in the project. Takes the `creative.id` of an ad, not the ad's own id. Returns the asset's id and URL; copying the same creative again returns the existing asset. For multi-step competitor research, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

creativeId.description: An ad's `creative.id`, not the ad's own id.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where a saved asset or new file lands. Its workspace's access applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's access applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_copy_creative_to_assets
title: Copy creative to Assets
